name: WF-315 — Seller Offer Package → Offer Dispatch, Delivery Receipt & Negotiation State

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const deal=input.deal??input; const offer=input.offer_package??deal.offer_package??{}; const dealId=deal.deal_id??deal.id; const leadId=deal.lead_id; const propertyId=deal.property_id; const channel=String(offer.preferred_channel??deal.preferred_channel??deal.channel??'').toLowerCase(); const recipient=offer.recipient??deal.seller_phone??deal.phone??deal.seller_email??deal.email; const message=String(offer.message??''); const offerPrice=Number(offer.opening_offer??offer.offer_price); const mao=Number(offer.dynamic_mao??deal.adjusted_mao??deal.dynamic_mao); const sellerReview=offer.seller_review_required!==false; const dnc=deal.dnc===true; const blockers=Array.isArray(deal.blockers)?deal.blockers:[]; const channelValid=['sms','email'].includes(channel); const identityReady=Boolean(dealId&&leadId&&propertyId); const recipientValid=Boolean(recipient); const priceValid=Number.isFinite(offerPrice)&&Number.isFinite(mao)&&offerPrice<=mao; const messageValid=message.length>0; let status='blocked',reason=''; if(dnc){status='blocked';reason='DNC protection';}else if(blockers.length){status='blocked';reason='active blockers';}else if(!identityReady){status='incomplete';reason='deal identity incomplete';}else if(!channelValid){status='incomplete';reason='unsupported communication channel';}else if(!recipientValid){status='incomplete';reason='seller recipient missing';}else if(!messageValid){status='incomplete';reason='offer message missing';}else if(!priceValid){status='blocked';reason='offer exceeds dynamic MAO';}else if(sellerReview){status='awaiting_human_authorization';reason='seller review/authorization required before external dispatch';}else{const dispatchId='WF315:'+dealId+':offer:'+Math.round(offerPrice*100);status='dispatch_ready';reason='offer package validated';return [{json:{...deal,workflow_id:'WF-315',workflow_name:'Seller Offer Package → Offer Dispatch, Delivery Receipt & Negotiation State',status,reason,dispatch_id:dispatchId,idempotency_key:dispatchId,dispatch:{channel,recipient,message,offer_price:offerPrice,dynamic_mao:mao,delivery_receipt_required:true},next_workflow:'WF-316',crm_activity:{activity_type:'seller_offer_dispatch_ready',deal_id:dealId,lead_id:leadId,property_id:propertyId,status,dispatch_id:dispatchId,dispatch:{channel,recipient,offer_price:offerPrice,dynamic_mao:mao,delivery_receipt_required:true}}}}];} return [{json:{...deal,workflow_id:'WF-315',workflow_name:'Seller Offer Package → Offer Dispatch, Delivery Receipt & Negotiation State',status,reason,next_workflow:status==='blocked'?'WF-126':'WF-314',crm_activity:{activity_type:'seller_offer_dispatch_validation',deal_id:dealId,lead_id:leadId,property_id:propertyId,status,reason}}}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { workflow_id: $json.workflow_id, status: $json.status, reason: $json.reason, next_workflow: $json.next_workflow, dispatch_id: $json.dispatch_id, dispatch: $json.dispatch, crm_persisted: true } }}

meta.description: Validates seller offer dispatch, enforces DNC and dynamic-MAO protections, creates deterministic dispatch/idempotency state, and requires delivery receipt.
